Table 256 — Test case description for 'TC_SECC_DC_VTB_ChargeParameterDiscovery_029'


<table><tr><td>TC Id</td><td>TC_SECC_DC_VTB_ChargeParameterDiscovery_029</td></tr><tr><td>Test objective</td><td>Test System executes GoodCase procedure and initiates a paused V2G communication session by sending a SessionStopReq message with the current SessionID, ChargingSession &#x27;Pause&#x27; and all additional mandatory parameters. After receipt of a valid SessionStopRes message, Test System waits for termination of the logical network by the SUT. Furthermore Test System checks that the SUT turns off the oscillator for the entire sleep mode. After &#x27;PIXIT_CMN_CMN_WakeUp&#x27; the SUT resumes the previously paused session by initiating a B1/B2 transition and waits for successful link detection (old logical network parameter) triggered by the SUT. Test System then executes Goodcase procedure and sends a ChargeParameterDiscoveryReq message the current SessionID, a valid RequestedEnergyTransferType, without MaxEntriesSAScheduleTuple and DepartureTime and all additional mandatory parameters. Test System then checks that the SUT sends a ChargeParameterDiscoveryReq message with the current SessionID, ResponseCode &#x27;OK&#x27;, EVSEProcessing &#x27;Finished&#x27;, a valid scheduleList, all additional mandatory parameters and the SAScheduleTuple which was selected by the EVCC in the previous session. If a valid ChargeParameterDiscoveryReq message with EVSEProcessing &#x27;Ongoing&#x27; was received before, the Test System sends another ChargeParameterDiscoveryReq message. This message sequence will be repeated until the processing of the charging information has finished or &#x27;V2G_EVCC_Ongoing_Timer&#x27; has expired.</td></tr><tr><td>Document reference</td><td>Document: ISO:15118-2:2014-IS Section(s): 15118-2:8.3.2; 15118-2:8.3.3; 15118-2:8.3.4; 15118-2:8.4.2; 15118-2:8.4.3; 15118-2:8.4.3.3; 15118-2:8.5.2.7; 15118-2:8.5.2.12; 15118-2:8.5.2.13; 15118-2:8.5.2.14; 15118-2:8.5.2.15; 15118-2:8.5.2.18; 15118-2:8.5.4.1; 15118-2:8.5.4.4; 15118-2:8.6.2.4.1; 15118-2:8.6.2.4.2; 15118-2:8.8.3.1; 15118-2:7.3.4; 15118-2:8.6.2.1; 15118-2:8.8.4.1; 15118-2:8.4.3.8.3; 15118-2:8.7.4.4; 15118-2:8.7.4.2; 15118-2:7.4</td></tr><tr><td>Referenced requirement(s)</td><td>[V2G2-179], [V2G2-180], [V2G2-181], [V2G2-183], [V2G2-218], [V2G2-220], [V2G2-582], [V2G2-752], [V2G2-278], [V2G2-279], [V2G2-294], [V2G2-608], [V2G2-299], [V2G2-609], [V2G2-300], [V2G2-304], [V2G2-310], [V2G2-313], [V2G2-610], [V2G2-611], [V2G2-327], [V2G2-614], [V2G2-331], [V2G2-364], [V2G2-365], [V2G2-372], [V2G2-373], [V2G2-366], [V2G2-391], [V2G2-395], [V2G2-457], [V2G2-634], [V2G2-664], [V2G2-665], [V2G2-666], [V2G2-667], [V2G2-672], [V2G2-677], [V2G2-773], [V2G2-915], [V2G2-741], [V2G2-745], [V2G2-832], [V2G2-665], [V2G2-304], [V2G2-725]</td></tr><tr><td>Config Id</td><td>CF_04_001</td></tr><tr><td>PICS selection</td><td>PICS_CMN_CMN_ChargingMode := dc, PICS_SECC_CMN_DepartureTime := false, PICS_SECC_CMN_Pause := true, FIXIT_CMN_CMN_WakeUp &lt; PICS_CMN_CMN_WakeUp, PICS_CMN_CMN_CombinedTesting := true, PICS_SECC_CMN_MaxEntriesSAScheduleTuple := false</td></tr><tr><td>PIXIT selection</td><td>PIXIT_SECC_CMN_SalesTariff := unknown</td></tr><tr><td colspan="2">PreCondition</td></tr><tr><td colspan="2">f_SECC_DC_PR_ConnectionStop_001, f_SECC_startSleepingPhase, f_SECC_CMN_PR_AuthorizationPausedSession_001</td></tr><tr><td colspan="2">Expected behavior</td></tr><tr><td colspan="2">f_SECC_DC_TB_VTB_ChargeParameterDiscovery_005</td></tr></table>

After receipt of a</td></tr></table>

<table><tr><td></td><td>valid SessionStopRes message, Test System waits for termination of the logical network by the SUT. Furthermore Test System checks that the SUT turns off the oscillator for the entire sleep mode. After &#x27;PIXIT_CMN_CMN_WakeUp&#x27; the SUT resumes the previously paused session by initiating a B1/B2 transition and waits for successful link detection (old logical network parameter) triggered by the SUT. Test System then executes Goodcase procedure and sends a ChargeParameterDiscoveryReq message the current SessionID, a valid RequestedEnergyTransferType, without MaxEntriesSAScheduleTuple, a DepartureTime and all additional mandatory parameters. Test System then checks that the SUT sends a ChargeParameterDiscoveryReq message with the current SessionID, ResponseCode &#x27;OK&#x27;, EVSEProcessing &#x27;Finished&#x27;, a valid scheduleList, all additional mandatory parameters and the SAScheduleTuple which was selected by the EVCC in the previous session. If a valid ChargeParameterDiscoveryReq message with EVSEProcessing &#x27;Ongoing&#x27; was received before, the Test System sends another ChargeParameterDiscoveryReq message. This message sequence will be repeated until the processing of the charging information has finished or &#x27;V2GEVCC_Ongoing_Timer&#x27; has expired.</td></tr><tr><td>Document reference</td><td>Document: ISO:15118-2:2014:IS Section(s): 15118-2:8.3.2; 15118-2:8.3.3; 15118-2:8.3.4; 15118-2:8.4.2; 15118-2:8.4.3; 15118-2:8.5.2.7; 15118-2:8.5.2.12; 15118-2:8.5.2.13; 15118-2:8.5.2.14; 15118-2:8.5.2.15; 15118-2:8.5.2.18; 15118-2:8.5.4.1; 15118-2:8.5.4.4; 15118-2:8.6.2.4.1; 15118-2:8.6.2.4.2; 15118-2:8.8.3.1; 15118-2:7.3.4; 15118-2:8.6.2.1; 15118-2:8.8.4.1; 15118-2:8.4.3.8.3; 15118-2:8.7.4.4; 15118-2:8.7.4.2; 15118-2:7.4</td></tr><tr><td>Referenced requirement(s)</td><td>[V2G2-179], [V2G2-180], [V2G2-181], [V2G2-183], [V2G2-218], [V2G2-220], [V2G2-582], [V2G2-752], [V2G2-278], [V2G2-279], [V2G2-294], [V2G2-608], [V2G2-299], [V2G2-609], [V2G2-300], [V2G2-304], [V2G2-313], [V2G2-610], [V2G2-611], [V2G2-327], [V2G2-614], [V2G2-331], [V2G2-364], [V2G2-365], [V2G2-372], [V2G2-373], [V2G2-366], [V2G2-391], [V2G2-395], [V2G2-457], [V2G2-634], [V2G2-664], [V2G2-665], [V2G2-666], [V2G2-667], [V2G2-672], [V2G2-773], [V2G2-915], [V2G2-741], [V2G2-745], [V2G2-832], [V2G2-665], [V2G2-303], [V2G2-725]</td></tr><tr><td>Config Id</td><td>CF_04_001</td></tr><tr><td>PICS selection</td><td>PICS_CMN_CMN_ChargingMode := dc, PICS_SECC_CMNDepartureTime := true, PICS_SECC_CMN_Pause := true, FIXIT_CMN_CMN_WakeUp &lt; PICS_CMN_CMN_WakeUp, PICS_CMN_CMNCombinedTesting := true, PICS_SECC_CMN_MaxEntriesSAScheduleTuple := false</td></tr><tr><td>PIXIT selection</td><td>PIXIT_SECC_CMN_SalesTariff := unknown</td></tr><tr><td colspan="2">PreCondition</td></tr><tr><td colspan="2">f_SECC_DC_PR_ConnectionStop_001, f_SECC_startSleepingPhase, f_SECC_CMN_Emphasis PausedSession_001</td></tr><tr><td colspan="2">Expected behavior</td></tr><tr><td colspan="2">f_SECC_DC_TB_VTB_ChargeParameterDiscovery_005</td></tr></table>

Table 263 — Test case description for 'TC_SECC_DC_VTB_ChargeParameterDiscovery_036'


<table><tr><td>TC Id</td><td>TC_SECC_DC_VTB_ChargeParameterDiscovery_036</td></tr><tr><td>Test objective</td><td>Test System executes GoodCase procedure and initiates a paused V2G communication session by sending a SessionStopReq message with the current SessionID, ChargingSession 'Pause' and all additional mandatory parameters. After receipt of a valid SessionStopRes message, Test System waits for termination of the logical network by the SUT. Furthermore Test System checks that the SUT turns off the oscillator for the entire sleep mode. After 'PIXIT_CMN_CMN_WakeUp' the SUT resumes the previously paused session by initiating a B1/B2 transition and waits for successful link detection (old logical network parameter) triggered by the SUT. Test System then executes Goodcase procedure and sends a ChargeParameterDiscoveryReq message the current SessionID, a valid RequestedEnergyTransferType, a MaxEntriesSAScheduleTuple, a DepartureTime and all additional mandatory parameters. Test System then checks that the SUT sends a ChargeParameterDiscoveryRes message with the current SessionID, ResponseCode 'OK', EVSEProcessing 'Finished', a valid scheduleList (MaxEntriesSAScheduleTuple is considered), all additional mandatory parameters and the SAScheduleTuple which was selected by the EVCC in the previous session. If a valid ChargeParameterDiscoveryRes message with EVSEProcessing</td></tr><tr><td></td><td>'Ongoing' was received before, the Test System sends another ChargeParameterDiscoveryReq message. This message sequence will be repeated until the processing of the charging information has finished or 'V2G_EVCC_Ongoing_Timer' has expired.</td></tr><tr><td>Document reference</td><td>Document: ISO:15118-2:2014:IS Section(s): 15118-2:8.3.2; 15118-2:8.3.3; 15118-2:8.3.4; 15118-2:8.4.2; 15118-2:8.4.3.8; 15118-2:8.4.3.3; 15118-2:8.5.2.7; 15118-2:8.5.2.12; 15118-2:8.5.2.13; 15118-2:8.5.2.14; 15118-2:8.5.2.15; 15118-2:8.5.2.18; 15118-2:8.5.4.1; 15118-2:8.5.4.4; 15118-2:8.6.2.4.1; 15118-2:8.6.2.4.2; 15118-2:8.8.3.1; 15118-2:7.3.4; 15118-2:8.6.2.1; 15118-2:8.8.4.1; 15118-2:8.4.3.8.3; 15118-2:8.7.4.4; 15118-2:8.7.4.2; 15118-2:7.4</td></tr><tr><td>Referenced requirement(s)</td><td>[V2G2-179], [V2G2-180], [V2G2-181], [V2G2-183], [V2G2-218], [V2G2-220], [V2G2-582], [V2G2-752], [V2G2-278], [V2G2-279], [V2G2-294], [V2G2-608], [V2G2-299], [V2G2-609], [V2G2-300], [V2G2-304], [V2G2-310], [V2G2-313], [V2G2-610], [V2G2-611], [V2G2-327], [V2G2-614], [V2G2-331], [V2G2-364], [V2G2-365], [V2G2-372], [V2G2-373], [V2G2-366], [V2G2-391], [V2G2-395], [V2G2-457], [V2G2-634], [V2G2-664], [V2G2-665], [V2G2-666], [V2G2-667], [V2G2-672], [V2G2-677], [V2G2-773], [V2G2-915], [V2G2-741], [V2G2-745], [V2G2-832], [V2G2-665], [V2G2-303], [V2G2-725]</td></tr><tr><td>Config Id</td><td>CF_04_001</td></tr><tr><td>PICS selection</td><td>PICS_CMN_CMN_ChargingMode := dC, PICS_SECC_CMNDepartureTime := true, PICS_SECC_CMN_Pause := true, FIXIT_CMN_CMN_WakeUp &lt; PICS_CMN_CMN_WakeUp, PICS_CMN_CMNCombinedTesting := true, PICS_SECC_CMN_MaxEntriesSAScheduleTuple := true</td></tr><tr><td>PIXIT selection</td><td>PIXIT_SECC_CMN_SalesTariff := unknown</td></tr><tr><td colspan="2">PreCondition</td></tr><tr><td colspan="2">f_SECC_DC_PR_ConnectionStop_001, f_SECC_startSleepingPhase, f_SECC_CMN授權AuthorizationPausedSession_001</td></tr><tr><td colspan="2">Expected behavior</td></tr><tr><td colspan="2">f_SECC_DC_TB_VTB_ChargeParameterDiscovery_005</td></tr></table>

After sending of a valid SessionStopRes message, Test System waits for termination of the logical network by the SUT, still detecting CP State B within the entire sleep mode. After 'par_SECC_Pmax0W' the SUT resumes the previously paused session by initiating a BCB toggle. (Test System has sent a PmaxScheduleList with the second Pmax element = 0W (par_SECC_Pmax0W) within ChargeParameterDiscoveryRes message before). After sending of a valid SessionStopRes message, Test System waits for termination of the logical network by the SUT, still detecting CP State B within the entire sleep mode. After &#x27;par_SECC_Pmax0W&#x27; the SUT resumes the previously paused session by initiating a BCB toggle. Furthermore Test System waits for successful link detection (old logical network parameter) triggered by the SUT. Test System then executes Goodcase procedure and sends a SupportedAppProtocolRes message with ResponseCode &#x27;OK_SuccessfulNegotiation&#x27;, a valid schema and all additional mandatory parameters. Test System then checks that the SUT sends a correct SessionSetupReq message with the previous SessionID, valid EvccID and all additional mandatory parameters.</td></tr><tr><td>Document reference</td><td>Document: ISO:15118-2:2014:IS Section(s): 15118-2:8.4.2; 15118-2:8.4.3.2.1; 15118-2:8.4.3.2.2; 15118-2:8.8.4.2; 15118-2:8.6.2.4.1; 15118-2:8.6.2.4.2; 15118-2:8.6.2.1</td></tr><tr><td>Referenced requirement(s)</td><td>[V2G2-179], [V2G2-180], [V2G2-181], [V2G2-183], [V2G2-188], [V2G2-189], [V2G2-485], [V2G2-390], [V2G2-394], [V2G2-659], [V2G2-660], [V2G2-661], [V2G2-662], [V2G2-740], [V2G2-744], [V2G2-748]</td></tr><tr><td>Config Id</td><td>CF_04_002</td></tr><tr><td>PICS selection</td><td>PICS_CMN_CMN_ChargingMode := dC, PICS_EVCC_CMN_PmaxSchedulewithZeroPow := sleepAfterCharge, par_SECC_Pmax0W &lt; PICS_CMN_CMN_WakeUp, PICS_CMN_CMN_CombinedTesting := true</td></tr><tr><td>PIXIT selection</td><td></td></tr><tr><td colspan="2">PreCondition</td></tr><tr><td colspan="2">f EVCC_DC_PR_WeldingDetectionOrSessionStop_002, f EVCC_setPwmMode, f EVCC_startSleepingPhase, f EVCC_CMN_PR_SupportedAppProtocolPausedSession_001</td></tr><tr><td colspan="2">Expected behavior</td></tr><tr><td colspan="2">f EVCC_CMN_TB_VTB^KSessionSetup_006</td></tr></table>

# 10.3.2.4.1 Common test cases


Table 433 — Test case description for 'TC_EVCC_CMN_VTB_ServiceDetailAndPaymentSelection_001'


<table><tr><td>TC Id</td><td>TCEVCC CMN_VTB_ServiceDetailAndPaymentSelection_001</td></tr><tr><td>Test objective</td><td>Test System executes GoodCase procedure and sends a ServiceDiscoveryRes message with the current SessionID, RESPONSECode 'Ok', PaymentOption 'Contract', valid SupportedEnergyTransferMode and ServiceList and all additional mandatory parameters.

# 10.3.2.4.2 AC specific test cases

Table	445	lists	the	test	case	description	for	'TC_EVCC_AC_VTB_ServiceDetailAndPaymentSelection_001'. 


Table 445 — Test case description for



'TC_EVCC_AC_VTB_ServiceDetailAndPaymentSelection_001'


<table><tr><td>TC Id</td><td>TCEVCC_AC_VTB_ServiceDetailAndPaymentSelection_001</td></tr><tr><td>Test objective</td><td>Test System executes GoodCase procedure and waits for a paused V2G communication session by receiving a SessionStopReq message with the current SessionID, ChargingSession &#x27;Pause&#x27; and all additional mandatory parameters. After sending of a valid SessionStopRes message, Test System waits for termination of the logical network by the SUT, still detecting CP State B within the entire sleep mode. After &#x27;PICS_CMN_CMN_WakeUp&#x27; Test System resumes the previously paused session by initiating a oscillator B1/B2 transition and waits for successful link detection (old logical network parameter) triggered by the SUT. Test System executes GoodCase procedure and sends a ServiceDiscoveryRes message with the current SessionID, ResponseCode &#x27;Ok&#x27;, PaymentOption &#x27;Contract&#x27; and &#x27;ExternalPayment&#x27;, valid SupportedEnergyTransferMode and ServiceList and all additional mandatory parameters. Test System then checks that the SUT sends a correct PaymentServiceSelectionReq message with the current SessionID, the previous SelectedPaymentOption, valid ServiceID and all additional mandatory parameters. If a ServiceDetailReq message was received before, the corresponding message sequence shall be executed by SUT and Test System previously.</td></tr><tr><td>Document reference</td><td>Document: ISO:15118-2:2014:IS Section(s): 15118-2:8.3.2; 15118-2:8.3.3; 15118-2:8.3.4; 15118-2:8.4.3.4.1; 15118-2:8.4.3.4.2; 15118-2:8.4.3.5.2; 15118-2:8.4.3.5.3; 15118-2:8.8.4.2.1; 15118-2:8.5.2.24; 15118-2:8.5.2.25; 15118-2:8.6.2.3.2; 15118-2:8.6.2.1; 15118-2:8.4.2</td></tr><tr><td>Referenced requirement(s)</td><td>[V2G2-179], [V2G2-180], [V2G2-181], [V2G2-183], [V2G2-201], [V2G2-202], [V2G2-431], [V2G2-747], [V2G2-349], [V2G2-350], [V2G2-351], [V2G2-352], [V2G2-380], [V2G2-659], [V2G2-660], [V2G2-661], [V2G2-662], [V2G2-740], [V2G2-744]</td></tr><tr><td>Config Id</td><td>CF_04_002</td></tr><tr><td>PICS selection</td><td>PICS_CMN_CMN_ChargingMode := aC, PICS_CMN_CMN_IdentificationMode := pnC, PICS_CMN_CMN_PkiName := PKI_1, FIXIT_CMN_CMN_WakeUp &gt; PICS_CMN_CMN_WakeUp, PICS_CMN_CMN_CombinedTesting := true</td></tr><tr><td>PIXIT selection</td><td>PIXIT_EVCC_CMN_VAS == unknown, FIXIT_CMN_CMN_PkiName := PKI_1, FIXIT_EVCC_CMN_Pause := pause</td></tr><tr><td colspan="2">PreCondition</td></tr><tr><td colspan="2">fEVCC_AC_PR_ServiceStop_002, fEVCC_setPwmMode, fEVCC_startSleepingPhase, fEVCC_CMN_PR_ServiceSetupPausedSession_001</td></tr><tr><td colspan="2">Expected behavior</td></tr><tr><td colspan="2">fEVCC_CMN_TB_VTB_ServiceDetailAndPaymentSelection_011</td></tr></table>


Table	446	lists	the	test	case	description	for	'TC_EVCC_AC_VTB_ServiceDetailAndPaymentSelection_002'. 



Table 446 — Test case description for 'TC_EVCC_AC_VTB_ServiceDetailAndPaymentSelection_002'


<table><tr><td>TC Id</td><td>TCEVCC_AC_VTB_ServiceDetailAndPaymentSelection_002</td></tr><tr><td>Test objective</td><td>Test System executes GoodCase procedure and waits for a paused V2G communication session by receiving a SessionStopReq message with the current SessionID, ChargingSession 'Pause' and all additional mandatory parameters. After sending of a valid SessionStopRes message, Test System waits for termination of the logical network by the SUT, still detecting CP State B within the entire sleep mode. Table	453	lists	the	test	case	description	for	'TC_EVCC_DC_VTB_ServiceDetailAndPaymentSelection_001'. 


Table 453 — Test case description for 'TC_EVCC_DC_VTB_ServiceDetailAndPaymentSelection_001'


<table><tr><td>TC Id</td><td>TCEVCC_DC_VTB_ServiceDetailAndPaymentSelection_001</td></tr><tr><td>Test objective</td><td>Test System executes GoodCase procedure and waits for a paused V2G communication session by receiving a SessionStopReq message with the current SessionID, ChargingSession &#x27;Pause&#x27; and all additional mandatory parameters. After sending of a valid SessionStopRes message, Test System waits for termination of the logical network by the SUT, still detecting CP State B within the entire sleep mode. After &#x27;PICS_CMN_CMN_WakeUp&#x27; Test System resumes the previously paused session by initiating 5 % duty cycle and waits for successful link detection (old logical network parameter) triggered by the SUT. Table 482 — Test case description for 'TC_EVCC_DC_VTB_PaymentServiceSelection_001'


<table><tr><td>TC Id</td><td>TCEVCC_DC_VTB_PaymentServiceSelection_001</td></tr><tr><td>Test objective</td><td>Test System executes GoodCase procedure and waits for a paused V2G communication session by receiving a SessionStopReq message with the current SessionID, ChargingSession &#x27;Pause&#x27; and all additional mandatory parameters. After sending of a valid SessionStopRes message, Test System waits for termination of the logical network by the SUT, still detecting CP State B within the entire sleep mode. After &#x27;PICS_CMN_CMN_WakeUp&#x27; Test System resumes the previously paused session by initiating 5% duty cycle and waits for successful link detection (old logical network parameter) triggered by the SUT. <table><tr><td>TC Id</td><td>TCEVCC_DC_VTB_PaymentServiceSelection_009</td></tr><tr><td>Test objective</td><td>Test System executes GoodCase procedure and waits for a paused V2G communication session by receiving a SessionStopReq message with the current SessionID, ChargingSession &#x27;Pause&#x27; and all additional mandatory parameters (Test System has sent a PmaxScheduleList with the first Pmax element = 0W (par_SECC_Pmax0W) within ChargeParameterDiscoveryRes message before). After sending of a valid SessionStopRes message, Test System waits for termination of the logical network by the SUT, still detecting CP State B within the entire sleep mode. After &#x27;par_SECC_Pmax0W&#x27; the SUT resumes the previously paused session by initiating a BCB toggle. Furthermore Test System waits for successful link detection (old logical network parameter) triggered by the SUT. Test System executes GoodCase procedure and sends a ServiceDetailRes message with the current SessionID, ResponseCode &#x27;OK&#x27;, requested ServiceID and all additional mandatory parameters. If another ServiceDetailReq message is received, Test System then sends a new valid ServiceDetailRes message with the corresponding ServiceID. <table><tr><td>TC Id</td><td>TCEVCC_DC_VTB_PaymentServiceSelection_016</td></tr><tr><td>Test objective</td><td>Test System executes GoodCase procedure and waits for a paused V2G communication session by receiving a SessionStopReq message with the current SessionID, ChargingSession 'Pause' and all additional mandatory parameters (Test System has sent a PmaxScheduleList with the second Pmax element = 0W (par_SECC_Pmax0W) within ChargeParameterDiscoveryRes message before). After sending of a valid SessionStopRes message, Test System waits for termination of the logical network by the SUT, still detecting CP State B within the entire sleep mode. After 'par_SECC_Pmax0W' the SUT resumes the previously paused session by initiating a BCB toggle. Furthermore Test System waits for successful link detection (old logical network parameter) triggered by the SUT. Test System executes GoodCase procedure and sends a ServiceDiscoveryRes message with the current SessionID, ResponseCode 'Ok', PaymentOption 'Contract' and 'ExternalPayment', valid SupportedEnergyTransferMode and all additional mandatory parameters. Test System then checks that the SUT sends a correct PaymentServiceSelectionReq message with the current SessionID, the previous SelectedPaymentOption, valid ServiceID and all additional mandatory parameters.</td></tr><tr><td>Document reference</td><td>Document: ISO:15118-2:2014:IS Section(s): 15118-2:8.3.2; 15118-2:8.3.3; 15118-2:8.3.4; 15118-2:8.4.3.4.1; 15118-2:8.4.3.4.2; 15118-2:8.4.3.5.2; 15118-2:8.4.2.1; 15118-2:8.4.3.5.3; 15118-2:8.4.2.1; 15118-2:8.5.2.24; 15118-2:8.5.2.25; 15118-2:8.6.2.4.1; 15118-2:8.6.2.1; 15118-2:8.4.2</td></tr><tr><td>Referenced requirement(s)</td><td>[V2G2-179], [V2G2-180], [V2G2-181], [V2G2-183], [V2G2-201], [V2G2-202], [V2G2-490], [V2G2-431], [V2G2-747], [V2G2-349], [V2G2-350], [V2G2-351], [V2G2-352], [V2G2-390], [V2G2-659], [V2G2-660], [V2G2-661], [V2G2-662] [V2G2-740], [V2G2-744]</td></tr><tr><td>Config Id</td><td>CF_04_002</td></tr><tr><td>PICS selection</td><td>PICS_CMN_CMN_ChargingMode := dC,PICS_CMN_CMN_IdentificationMode := eIM,PICSEVCC_CMN_PmaxSchedulewithZeroPow := sleepAfterCharge,par_SECC_Pmax0W &lt; PICS_CMN_CMN_WakeUp,PICS_CMN_CMN_CombinedTesting := true</td></tr><tr><td>PIXIT selection</td><td>PIXIT_EVCC_CMN_VAS := none_</td></tr><tr><td colspan="2">PreCondition</td></tr><tr><td colspan="2">fEVCC_DC_PR_WeldingDetectionOrSessionStop_002, fEVCC_setPwmMode,fEVCC_startSleepingPhase, fEVCC_CMN_PR_ServiceSetupPausedSession_001</td></tr><tr><td colspan="2">Expected behavior</td></tr><tr><td colspan="2">fEVCC_CMN_TB_VTB_PaymentServiceSelection_004</td></tr></table>
